data.title: NeuroSense Provides Update on Nasdaq Listing Compliance
data.description: A company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts has met Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement, signaling compliance with the stock market's regulations. However, the company still needs more time to meet the minimum market value requirement. They plan to request a hearing with Nasdaq's Panel to discuss this matter further. The developments were announced on October 2, 2026. NeuroSense Therapeutics Ltd. is working towards satisfying the criteria set by Nasdaq to maintain its standing in the market.

data.title: UMBRO, STEVEN MENA AND WSS CONNECT FÚTBOL CULTURES IN EXCLUSIVE COLLECTION
data.description: Los Angeles-based designer Steven Mena merges the iconic football heritage of Umbro with the unique style and culture of Southeast LA. The collaboration, known as Umbro x WSS, was unveiled by WSS today in Los Angeles on October 2, 2026. This collaboration aims to blend Umbro's English football tradition with Mena's LA roots to create a trendy and culturally rich collection.

data.title: Allison Completes Partial Redemption of 4.750% Senior Notes due 2027
data.description: On October 2, 2026, Allison Transmission Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: ALSN) disclosed the successful partial redemption of $100 million in principal of its 4.750% Senior Notes due 2027 on September 30, 2026.

data.title: EPAM Announces Date for Third Quarter Earnings Release and Conference Call
data.description: A prominent digital transformation services and product engineering company, EPAM Systems, Inc. (NYSE: EPAM), based in Newtown, Pennsylvania, has scheduled a conference call for Thursday, November 5, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time to review its financial performance in the third quarter of 2026. This call will offer insights into the company's recent financial results, key metrics, and strategic outlook.

data.title: CHAI offers engineers 50% more total compensation, paid in cash
data.description: In Palo Alto, a Meta engineer has been extended an offer worth $900,000 as the social AI company CHAI, supported by CoreWeave and AMD Ventures, looks to expand its team. The compensation strategy for engineering roles was outlined on October 2nd, 2026.

data.title: Commonwealth Care Alliance® and CareSource Employees Raise $50,000 for Advocates through Workplace Giving Campaign
data.description: In Boston on October 2, 2026, employees from Commonwealth Care Alliance (CCA) and CareSource have rallied to raise a significant amount of $50,000 for Advocates, a nonprofit organization in Massachusetts. This generous contribution will aid Advocates in expanding their services to benefit the over 50,000 residents and families they support annually.

data.title: Dow Jones Futures: Nasdaq Hits High As Nvidia, SpaceX, Bloom Energy Flash Buy Signals. What To Do Now.
data.description: The Nasdaq index has reached new highs, with prominent companies like Nvidia, SpaceX, and Bloom Energy showing strong buy indicators. Despite this, a large portion of the market continues to exhibit weakness. Investors are advised on potential actions to take in light of these developments. The post also suggests strategies to consider in response to this market activity.

data.title: AI tricks 26 out of 54 in video calls to believe it's human. The Griffin model isn't available for purchase.
data.description: According to Tavus, during a one-minute video call, 26 out of 54 individuals believed that their new Griffin model was a human being. These findings are based on the company's internal assessment, and as of now, the Griffin model is not available for purchase by retail customers.

data.title: Vertical Aerospace Receives Continued Listing Standard Notice from NYSE
data.description: In an announcement made today, Vertical Aerospace, a leading aerospace and technology company specializing in electric vertical take-off and landing (“eVTOL”) aircraft, disclosed that it was notified by the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) on September 9, 2026. The notice stated that the Company, listed under the ticker symbol EVTL, presently falls short of meeting the NYSE's continuous listing guideline mandating a minimum average closing price of $1.00 for its ordinary shares.

data.title: Arcosa, Inc. Announces Commencement of Bondholder Calls
data.description: Arcosa, Inc. (NYSE: ACA) based in Dallas, a supplier of infrastructure products and services, revealed plans to conduct quarterly bondholder calls. This initiative aims to provide the holders of the Notes, the Trustee, beneficial owners, potential buyers of the Notes, securities analysts, and financial institutions involved in market making an opportunity to inquire about the company's financial updates. These calls will be initiated following the release of the company's quarterly financial information, starting with the Quarterly Report.

data.title: Ethereum's zkAPI enables anonymous AI payments with USDC, safeguarding user privacy while querying models.
data.description: Ethereum's zkAPI allows users to prepay using USDC and access AI models through cryptographic proofs. This ensures that no single party has access to both the identity of the user and the nature of their query.

data.title: Aardvark Therapeutics Announces Inducement Grant Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
data.description: On October 1, 2026, Aardvark Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: AARD), a biopharmaceutical company in San Diego, revealed that a new employee was given an inducement award. This award includes a stock option allowing the purchase of 60,000 shares of common stock. Aardvark is known for specializing in the development of small-molecule therapeutics for metabolic diseases by activating innate homeostatic pathways.

data.title: Caesars Entertainment, Inc. to Release 2026 Third Quarter Results on October 27, 2026
data.description: Caesars Entertainment, Inc. is set to disclose its third-quarter financial results on October 27, 2026, after the market closes. The Company, listed as CZR on NASDAQ, will not conduct an earnings call due to its impending merger with Fertitta Entertainment, revealed on May 28, 2026. Following the merger, Caesars’ common stock will be delisted from NASDAQ as it transitions into a private entity.

data.title: Surf Air Mobility Announces Employee Inducement Awards Under NYSE Rule 303A.08
data.description: Los Angeles-based Surf Air Mobility Inc. disclosed that it has provided inducement awards to two recent hires, in accordance with NYSE's Listed Company Manual Rule 303A.08. The employees were granted awards on October 2, 2026. This move comes as Surf Air Mobility, listed under NYSE as SRFM, continues to establish itself as a key player in the air mobility sector.

data.title: Block to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Results
data.description: Block, Inc. (NYSE: XYZ) based in Oakland, California, will announce its financial performance for Q3 2026 on November 3, 2026, following the market closure. A conference call and earnings webcast are scheduled for the same day at 2:00 p.m. PT / 5:00 p.m. ET to review these results. Those interested in joining the call or accessing the webcast can register via the Events & Presentations section of Block’s platform.
